overall_worst.defect: The till screenshots on At the till use three different widths (about 836, 418 and 546 px), two of them double-framed and centred, with captions aligned to each image's edge instead of the text column. The page looks assembled, not designed.
overall_worst.fix: Render every till screenshot through one figure component: text-column width (or one fixed max-width for portrait sheets, left-aligned), one 1 px border and radius, no outer padded card, and the caption flush with the text column's left edge. Crop the payment screen to the part that matters.
